race.comment: HOOROO (4) is hard to ignore as he looks to keep his unbeaten record in tact. He's improving at each start and gets another chance to flex his muscle. THEE CREEK (5) is worth forgiving on the strength of his pillar-to-post win at Rockhampton two runs back. Was too bad to be true last time and has the ability to rebound strongly in this easier assignment. KEEP ON RUNNING (3) resumes and while he's yet to fire a shot fresh, if he's able to pick up from where he left off last campaign he's in this up to his ears. DALT JAZ (2) has been freshened with 47 days after a disappointing effort at Gordonvale. His form prior was solid though and he reunites with Wiggins, who's 2/2 aboard.
